_what: Per-file provenance and SHA-256 for the 27-file public ASR bake-off corpus. Generated by hashing a measured tree; never hand-edited. NO AUDIO IS REDISTRIBUTED — this file is how a reader rebuilds it from the publishers and proves the bytes match.

ami.name: AMI Meeting Corpus
ami.audio_stream_note: The headset MIXDOWN (near-field lapel/headset channels summed to one 16 kHz mono track), NOT a distant array microphone. Confirmed byte-for-byte: an HTTP Range read of the mirror's EN2002a.Mix-Headset.wav hashes identically to the local ami/audio/EN2002a.wav, while Array1-01 and Array2-01 hash differently at the same offset.
ami.cite: Carletta, J. et al. (2005). The AMI Meeting Corpus: A Pre-announcement.

earnings21.name: Earnings-21
earnings21.license_audio: Not separately licensed by the publisher; the repository's LICENSE.md covers 'the transcripts and associated text files'. Audio is fetched from the publisher, never redistributed here.
earnings21.cite: Del Rio, M. et al. (2021). Earnings-21: A Practical Benchmark for ASR in the Wild. Interspeech 2021.

ami_public_manual_1.6.2.zip.note: AMI manual annotations. Only the `words/` members this corpus needs are extracted; the archive itself is an intermediate and may be deleted after extraction.
